==================
If block statement
==================

Module M
    Sub Main()
        If x > 0 Then
            Print("positive")
        End If
    End Sub
End Module

---

(source_file
  (blank_line)
  (type_declaration
    (module_block
      (identifier)
      (method_declaration
        (identifier)
        (parameter_list)
        (if_statement
          (binary_expression
            (identifier)
            (integer_literal))
          (call_statement
            (invocation
              (identifier)
              (argument_list
                (argument
                  (string_literal))))))))))

==================
If ElseIf Else statement
==================

Module M
    Sub Main()
        If x > 0 Then
            Print("positive")
        ElseIf x < 0 Then
            Print("negative")
        Else
            Print("zero")
        End If
    End Sub
End Module

---

                  (string_literal)))))

==================
Select Case with simple values
==================

Module M
    Sub Main()
        Select Case day
            Case 1
                Print("Mon")
            Case 2
                Print("Tue")
            Case Else
                Print("other")
        End Select
    End Sub
End Module

==================
Select Case with range
==================

Module M
    Sub Main()
        Select Case score
            Case 0 To 59
                grade = "F"
            Case 60 To 69
                grade = "D"
            Case 70 To 79
                grade = "C"
            Case Else
                grade = "A"
        End Select
    End Sub
End Module

==================
Select Case with Is comparison
==================

Module M
    Sub Main()
        Select Case n
            Case Is < 0
                sign = -1
            Case Is > 0
                sign = 1
            Case Else
                sign = 0
        End Select
    End Sub
End Module

==================
Try Catch Finally
==================

Module M
    Sub Main()
        Try
            Open()
            DoWork()
        Catch ex As IOException
            Log("IO error")
        Catch ex As Exception
            Log("other")
        Finally
            Close()
        End Try
    End Sub
End Module
